page_title: LYO 2-0 NAN | Lyon v Nantes 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+4' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Alban Lafont was alert and the score remains the same.
90+3' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 9:5.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal!
87' The resulting corner from Florent Mollet (Nantes) is cleared by the defence.
83' Pierre Sage has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) replacing Alexandre Lacazette.
83' That's the end of the game for Said Benrahma, who is replaced by Abner (Lyon).
82' Now Nantes have a corner.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Louis Leroux (Nantes) will replace Matthis Abline.
81' Antoine Kombouare has decided to substitute Pedro Chirivella and he is replaced by Dehmaine Assoumani (Nantes).
80' Lyon keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
78' Ball possession – 58:42.
74' The referee signals a substitution. Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) is brought on as a substitute for Corentin Tolisso.
74' Pierre Sage decides to make a substitution. Malick Fofana will be replaced by Tanner Tessmann (Lyon).
74' Nantes are ruled offside.
73' The substitution is prepared. Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Moses Simon.
71' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) has tested the patience of referee Marc Bollengier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
71' A rebound spins to Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post.
71' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
70' The statistic for corner kicks – 6:7.
66' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marc Bollengier had an easy-decision to make.
66' It is time for a substitution. Florent Mollet (Nantes) is on for Sorba Thomas.
65' Antoine Kombouare has decided to make a change. Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) replaces Jean-Philippe Gbamin.
65' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Rayan Cherki as he is replaced by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon).
64' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
63' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Corentin Tolisso (Lyon).
61' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) for his blatant foul.
61' The corner is swung in but Nantes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
60' Moses Simon (Nantes) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nantes.
57' Total attempts – 10:5.
54' 2 - 0 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Nicolas Pallois (Nantes), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 2:0.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lyon.

53' A great solo effort from Said Benrahma (Lyon) and he attempts to surprise the goalkeeper with a long-range shot towards the bottom right corner. Alban Lafont has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lyon are going to take it.
52' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
49' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
49' Nantes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Nantes can continue in their attacking effort.
48' An attempted cross from Sorba Thomas (Nantes) is cleared. Nantes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
47' Lyon concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) trips an opposition player and Marc Bollengier signals a foul.
45+1' The corner is swung in but Nantes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

45' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nicolas Cozza (Nantes). The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Nantes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
44' Malick Fofana (Lyon) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the left post.
42' The resulting set piece from Lyon is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
41' A rebound spins to Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the left post.
40' Lyon hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
37' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
36' 2:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
33' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nantes comes to nothing.
31' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marc Bollengier signals.
29' The resulting corner, taken by Rayan Cherki (Lyon), comes to nothing.
27' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle after Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
24' Nantes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
22' 1 - 0 Goal! Said Benrahma sends a precise cross into the box, Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) latches on to it and puts the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
21' Lyon win a corner.
17' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires well wide of the left post.
14' Moses Simon (Nantes) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
12' Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Nantes) prepares to take a corner kick.
11' Moses Simon (Nantes) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
9' The percentage of ball possession is – 73:27.
5' Lyon take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
2' Some neat passing and movement from Lyon as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
1' The first half has started.
Nantes will kick-off.
Marc Bollengier will supervise the game today.
